pages.text: Devouring aspects consume valid items to give cultivation base plus a corresponding elemental foundation and comprehension when finishing a minigame or through a completed exercise cycle. However, you will also gain more demonic foundation than the other gains you had received.

$(br2)Devouring aspects can also be used to consume soul cores at a faster rate with the side effect of a higher demonic foundation gain. $(br2)Devouring aspects can be learned through killing other players or at a lower chance you can kill zombies/husks instead
